sermon.title: Keys to Restoration— February 20, 2022
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: Christ is preparing a glorious bride. Jesus prayed that we be one, yet the church is deeply divided. Lies, discord and following the majority divide us; humility, prayer and agreement on Jesus restore unity.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Message begins at 27:46 after worship.
